community.title: Peer Student Supporter (NUS SoC)
community.bodyText:
- Provide support to fellow students, providing students a listening ear as they navigate through academic challenges. 
 - Maintain an environment for students to rest and take their mind off studying. 
 - Conduct events to spread awareness on mental health.

community.title: Anti-scam Workshop
community.bodyText:
- Conduct anti-scam workshop for the more vulnerable members of the society. 
 - Aim to spread digital literacy and online safety in the current age of AI for the elderly community to recognise and avoid scams.
tags: Do not scam anyone, especially the elderlies
